# FIRMS2 (Fire Information and Resource Management System)

> > Global real-time fire detection and monitoring platform leveraging MODIS, VIIRS, and LANDSAT satellite imagery for wildfire tracking and alerts.

FIRMS2 is NASA's LANCE (Land, Atmosphere Near real-time Capability for EOS) system that provides near real-time fire hotspot detection, archived fire data downloads, and regional fire monitoring services. It integrates data from multiple polar-orbiting satellites (NOAA-20, NOAA-21, S-NPP) and geostationary systems to support wildfire management and research globally.

## Key Topics

- FIRMS (Fire Information and Resource Management System)
- LANCE (Land, Atmosphere Near real-time Capability for EOS)
- MODIS (Moderate Resolution Imaging Spectroradiometer)
- VIIRS (Visible Infrared Imaging Radiometer Suite)
- NOAA-20 and NOAA-21 satellites
- S-NPP (Suomi National Polar-orbiting Partnership)
- Real-time fire detection
- Fire hotspot data
- Wildfire monitoring
- Burned area assessment
- Fire alerts
- Satellite imagery
- Geospatial data
- Archive download
- Collection-2 (data standard)

## Core Services

- [Global FIRMS Portal](https://firms2.modaps.eosdis.nasa.gov): Global fire mapping system with near real-time MODIS and VIIRS data from multiple satellites.
- [US/Canada Regional Monitoring](https://firms2.modaps.eosdis.nasa.gov/usfs): Real-time fire monitoring and alerts specifically for US and Canada regions with regional fire data.
- [Archive Download](https://firms2.modaps.eosdis.nasa.gov/download): Download archived fire data from MODIS, VIIRS, and LANDSAT satellites for historical analysis and research.

## Updates & News

- [What's New](https://firms2.modaps.eosdis.nasa.gov/content/notifications/firms/news.html): Updates on FIRMS products including Collection-2, GOES-19, and bug fixes.
